fato_historico: 1965: The 1964–65 New York World's Fair closes after two years and more than 51 million attendees.
energia_do_dia: As the grand curtains close on yesterday's grand exhibits, you may feel an urge to curate your own future. Much like a world fair of memories, your mind is brimming with innovation. It is a good time to synthesize your unique ideas and consider which projects deserve the spotlight as you step into a fresh chapter of discovery.
frase_do_dia: Your unique perspective is the bridge to tomorrow's beautiful possibilities.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of your true, authentic spiritual power.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let your eccentric spirit shine brightly today.
